title: Vine tomatoes simmering in the casserole

tokens.v: The oxblood casserole sits among the vine tomatoes on the red sweep with its lid off and leaning against its side, the pot full of tomatoes softening into a glossy sauce, a wooden spoon resting across the rim and a wisp of steam rising into the hard sun, its brass badge turned to camera. 50mm from just above the rim, the pot filling the lower half of the frame.
